note: Mercer County IL publishes its tax map only through the Portico (Sidwell/mygisonline) HTML5 viewer, which exposes no public ArcGIS REST or file download. The maps.mercercounty.org ArcGIS host serves Mercer County, New Jersey (East Windsor Twp, 142k parcels), not Illinois. Searches found only paid/commercial Mercer IL parcel files (Regrid, Rockford Map, MappingSolutionsGIS). No queryable public Illinois parcel service was found.
